title: Stronger rough-Chen distribution and the signed prime margin
objective: Use the exact primary stronger-distribution inputs of the referenced rough-Chen approach to attempt new signed arithmetic for the original prime margin, checking actual coefficient and vector hypotheses.
deliverables: At most two actual signed mechanisms
New arithmetic estimate or precise first failed inequality
success_criteria: Rough prime-plus-P2 is not promoted to a prime-pair lower bound
Small and Goldbach-size residue levels are distinguished
All well-factorable and smoothness hypotheses are checked
No numerical source certificate is treated as proof of the analytic transfer
stop_conditions: Pair8 plus root primary-access2, total10, one round
No further supplement, helper, retrieval, paid call, publication or external message
Full Goldbach objective remains active unless actually achieved
